book.anima.codex.advanced.golems.name: Assemble Your Golem
book.anima.codex.advanced.golems.goal: Fit one Head, one Torso, two Arms and two Legs to a Fabricator.
book.anima.codex.advanced.golems.p0.text:
Make one Head, one Torso, two Arms and two Legs with the [Golem Part Assembler](entry://anima:codex/components/golem_assembler). Then craft a Golem Fabricator.\
\
You will need a [Soul Leash](entry://anima:codex/magic/soul_leash) or the Incorporeal spell to pilot the finished golem. It does not follow you like an animated ally.
book.anima.codex.advanced.golems.p1.text: Place the Golem Fabricator with three blocks of clear height. Right-click any part of the rack to install one head, one torso, two arms and two legs. Each fitted body part appears immediately. Leave room in front of the rear rails.
book.anima.codex.advanced.golems.p1_cont: The completed golem belongs to the player who placed its rack. Only its owner can add parts, pilot it or open its cargo.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pilot_golem.go: Pilot your golem with a Soul Leash or Incorporeal.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pilot_golem.p0:
Use a Soul Leash, or right-click your golem during Incorporeal. Move and jump normally. Left-click to attack or dig; right-click heavy controls.\
\
Incorporeal: sneak + right-click to leave as a spirit, then again to return. Soul Leash: sneak to return. Walking off the rack detaches the golem permanently and frees the rack.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pilot_golem.p1: Your golem has 50 hearts and armored skin. Mobs ignore it until it hits them, then they can fight back. Piloting uses Survival abilities. Hold attack to mine one block at half normal stone-tool speed. Left-click creatures to strike them. Repair damage with Iron Ingots while outside the golem.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pilot_golem.p2:
Press H (rebindable) for 3×3 hammer/shovel mode. Gold outlines preview the blocks. It takes 4.5 times a single-block action; releasing attack or changing targets resets progress.\
\
Hard ores, unbreakable blocks, containers and machines stay intact. Claims and Adventure restrictions apply. Piloted golems collect nearby drops.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pilot_golem.p3:
Your inventory key previews 27 cargo slots while piloting; you cannot move items then. Return to your body and shift-right-click the golem to transfer items.\
\
Cargo stays when you leave. Destruction drops only the cargo and returns you to your body. Protect your original body while away.
book.anima.codex.advanced.golem_controls: Optional: operate Large Levers and Buttons from your golem.
Attach Large Levers and Large Buttons to floors, walls or ceilings. Only a piloted Workshop Golem can operate them: aim and right-click.
Both output strength-15 redstone. The lever stays toggled; the button releases after one second. Use them for doors and machinery.

A piloted Workshop Golem can also start a [Synthetic Resonator](entry://anima:codex/advanced/synthetic_resonator) above a Bone Cage. Aim at the resonator and right-click to spin it, doubling cage suction range.\
\
This upgrade stays active after you leave the golem, including across world reloads.
book.anima.codex.advanced.synthetic_reso: Optional: double a Bone Cage’s suction range.

Place a Synthetic Resonator on top of a complete Bone Cage. Its pale paddles start stationary. While piloting a golem, right-click the rotor to start it. Ordinary players cannot activate it.\
\
A spinning resonator doubles suction range from 6 to 12 blocks. The cage must still be open and empty to draw creatures.

The resonator stays spinning across saves and reloads. Removing it restores normal range immediately. Breaking its supporting cage also drops the upgrade. A placed resonator always starts stationary; use a golem to activate it again.
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.name: Make a God
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.goal: Use one God Soul and three different code items to create a god.
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p0.title: Build the fabricator
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p0.text:
Craft one Deity Fabricator and four Plinths. Place the fabricator on Soul Stone with room for its three-block height.\
\
Place plinths three blocks north, east, south and west of its base, all at the base’s height. The preview shows their positions. Only the center needs Soul Stone.
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p1.title: Soul and code
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p1.text:
Place a God Soul bottle on one plinth and three different item types on the others, in any order. Those three types become the god's code.\
\
The combination must be unique; individual items can belong to other codes. Renaming or enchanting does not change an item's type. Choose items you can gather again for shrines.
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p2.title: Choose the god
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p2.text:
Right-click the fabricator to open Create a God. Enter a unique name of up to 32 characters. Changing capitalization does not make a used name available.\
\
Use the arrows to choose its traits. Hover a choice for its effect. Read [Choose a God’s Traits](entry://anima:codex/advanced/god_choices) before confirming.
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p3.title: Create the god
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.p3.text:
Choose a carried item as its sacred item. Each worship action consumes one, so choose something easy to replace.\
\
Press Create god. The soul and code items are consumed. After six seconds the god is created and the bottle returns. Breaking the structure before completion refunds the inputs.
book.anima.codex.advanced.gods.structure: One Soul Stone under the center. Four Plinths three blocks out. The Fabricator places its upper sections automatically.
book.anima.codex.advanced.god_choices.go: Choose its blessing, curse, power, sound and appearance.
book.anima.codex.advanced.god_choices.p0:
The blessing is a helpful effect your priests give the god's followers for 60 seconds, such as Regeneration, Strength, Speed or Night Vision.\
\
The curse is a harmful effect they lay for 15 seconds on everyone nearby who is not devout, monsters included, such as Slowness, Poison or Blindness. Both are level I.
book.anima.codex.advanced.god_choices.p1:
Choose one of the twelve powers listed next. Priests can use it while their god leads the Pantheon; a tie counts.\
\
Each use costs one worship and has a two-minute cooldown. If a power has no valid target or task, it costs nothing.
book.anima.codex.advanced.god_choices.p2:
Bloom: bonemeals the 3×3 area around you three times over.\
Harvest: reaps ripe crops within 4 blocks and replants them.\
Shepherd: teleports eligible animals within 24 blocks to safe spots beside you.\
Quarry: digs a 3×3 tunnel three deep where you look.\
Kiln: smelts the whole stack in your offhand.
book.anima.codex.advanced.god_choices.p3:
Smite: lightning within 48 blocks.\
Tempest: five minutes of thunder.\
Clear Skies: ten minutes without rain.\
Mending: repairs a quarter of gear durability.\
Pilgrimage: travel to another shrine of your god.\
Sanctuary: fully heals and cleanses nearby followers.\
Banish: pushes non-devout creatures away.
book.anima.codex.advanced.god_choices.p4:
The sound plays at the god's shrines each time it is worshipped, from Serene chimes to a Scary dragon's growl. It plays as you choose it; click its name to hear it again.\
\
The icon appears above shrines and in the Pantheon. The colour, one of sixteen swatches, tints the icon and the god's shrines.
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.name: Build a Shrine
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.goal: Build a shrine to your god or another player’s god.
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.p0.tex:
Craft one Deity Shrine and three Offering Plates using the recipes here. You need a god’s three code items to dedicate it. Find them in the [Pantheon](entry://anima:codex/advanced/pantheon).\
\
You can build a shrine to another player’s god. Creating your own god is optional.
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.p1.tex:
Place plates immediately north, east, south or west of the shrine, at the same height as its base. Use any three of these four positions; diagonals do not count.\
\
Right-click a plate with an item to set one down. Right-click it again to take the item back. Breaking a plate drops its item.
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.p2.tex:
Put one of each of a god's three code items on the plates, in any order, then right-click the shrine with an empty hand. The Pantheon shows every god's code.\
\
The three items are consumed once to dedicate the shrine. Its colour and floating icon identify its god. Later worship uses the god's sacred item, not another set of code items.
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.p3.tex:
Only the player who set up a shrine can give it to another god, the same way.\
\
Rename a shrine at an anvil before placing it. Travel lists show its name, and it keeps the name when broken. Breaking a shrine removes it from its god.
book.anima.codex.advanced.worship.struct: Put plates on any three cardinal sides, directly beside the shrine at the same height. One valid arrangement is shown.
book.anima.codex.advanced.devotion.name: Become Devout
book.anima.codex.advanced.devotion.goal: Offer the sacred item five times in a row to the same god.
book.anima.codex.advanced.devotion.p0.te:
Right-click the shrine holding the god's sacred item. One is taken, the shrine plays the god's sound, and you gain one worship with the god. Its standing in the Pantheon rises by one.\
\
You can worship once every five minutes, whichever god you choose. In creative mode there is no wait. Worship is kept through death.
book.anima.codex.advanced.devotion.p1.te:
Worship the same god five times in a row to become devout to it. A title tells you when you are.\
\
Worshipping any other god ends your devotion, and the count starts again with that god. Only the devout can become priests or use a Priest Rod's powers.
book.anima.codex.advanced.devotion.p2.te:
Your worship balance with each god pays for Priest Rod actions and shrine travel. Each successful action or journey costs one.\
\
Spending worship does not break devotion or lower the god's lifetime standing in the Pantheon. Worship again to refill your balance; the five-minute wait is shared across all gods.
book.anima.codex.advanced.priests.name: Use a Priest Rod
book.anima.codex.advanced.priests.goal: Dedicate a Priest Rod and spend worship on its abilities.
book.anima.codex.advanced.priests.p0.tex:
While devout, right-click one of your god's shrines with a Priest Rod. It becomes the Rod of that god, and the god's three code items circle it while you hold it.\
\
If you later turn to another god, become devout to it and use the rod on its shrine to rededicate it.
book.anima.codex.advanced.priests.p1.tex:
Left-click your bound rod to open its menu. Choose Power (yellow bolt), Curse (purple eye) or Blessing (green heart). The rod remembers your choice; select it again to clear it.\
\
Selecting closes the menu. Right-click to cast. Choosing is free; casting costs one worship and requires devotion. The menu shows worship and cooldowns.
book.anima.codex.advanced.priests.p2.tex:
Curse affects non-devout players and monsters within 16 blocks for 15 seconds. Blessing affects devout players in that range for 60 seconds, including you.\
\
Both have a 60-second cooldown. Power has a two-minute cooldown. Failed actions cost nothing. PvP protections apply.
book.anima.codex.advanced.priests.p3.tex:
Invoke uses the god's power (see [Make a God](entry://anima:codex/advanced/gods)). It works only while your god is the most worshipped, or tied for it, and has a two-minute cooldown.\
\
Raise your god's standing by worshipping, and by bringing others to worship it.
Build a second shrine and spend worship to travel between them.

Dedicate two shrines to the same god. Worship at least once, then sneak-right-click either shrine and choose the other. Travel works across dimensions.\
\
Each trip costs one worship and has a three-second cooldown. The destination needs clear, dry ground. Refused trips cost nothing; devotion is not required.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pantheon.name: Read the Pantheon
book.anima.codex.advanced.pantheon.goal: Look up gods, code items and worship standings.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pantheon.p0.te:
Right-click a Pantheon to list every god, most worshipped first. Use it to find a god’s three code items before building a shrine.\
\
Each row shows the god's icon in its colour, its name, its total worship beside a Nether Star, and its three code items. The line below lists its blessing, curse and power.
book.anima.codex.advanced.pantheon.p1.te:
The star marks the leading god. A tie also allows its priests to use Power. Your god is outlined in gold.\
\
Hover a row to see its sacred item, effects, sound, shrines and creator. Scroll or drag the side bar to see more gods.
book.anima.codex.advanced.deity_hammer.g: Optional: prepare an arena and summon an existing god’s avatar.
book.anima.codex.advanced.deity_hammer.p:
The Deity Hammer calls an existing god into an endgame boss battle. Bring enchanted Netherite or better, strong weapons, healing and Resistance potions, and Foci with fresh souls. Keep an open, level arena with room to run.\
\
Find the god's code in the [Pantheon](entry://anima:codex/advanced/priests). Victory permanently removes that god, so choose your challenge carefully.
Place the hammer under open sky with a clear 5×5 area extending eight blocks above. Put three Offering Plates immediately beside it at the same height: north, east, south or west, as for a shrine.

Place the three code items on the plates and right-click the hammer. It consumes the offerings and unfolds. A pulsar calls down the Avatar over six seconds, then switches off.\
\
The avatar is protected during descent, then vulnerable. A god can answer only one challenge at a time. Peaceful prevents the ritual.
book.anima.codex.advanced.deity_hammer.s: Use any three cardinal sides for plates. Keep the 5×5×8 space above clear, with open sky. One arrangement is shown.
Defeat the avatar. Victory permanently removes its god.

The avatar has 900 base health and three phases. Watch its warning marks rather than standing still to trade blows.\
\
Starfall marks positions before three celestial strikes: leave each circle. Event Horizon sends out a thin, low expanding ring: jump over the moving edge or fly above it. Only the ring hurts; the floor inside it is safe.

Between spells, the avatar chases players for six to eight seconds and switches targets in a group.\
\
Raised arms and a fixed circle give a one-second claw warning. It stops to wind up: move outside the circle. It stays vulnerable while chasing. Brief stationary recovery windows give you time to strike or heal.

Below two-thirds health, the Astral Lance draws a line of light before firing. Sidestep the line.\
\
Below one-third health, Gravity Collapse marks a large circle. Escape it before detonation. Warnings become shorter and attacks stronger in this final phase. Healing, protection and movement spells help you survive.

Damage the avatar to join; bystanders do not count. Each extra fighter adds 75%% effective endurance: two face 1.75× solo endurance, three face 2.5×. Joining never refills its health bar.\
\
The largest party size lasts for that attempt, even after departures. Spread out and protect whoever activated the hammer.

Defeating the avatar permanently removes its god from the Pantheon. That god's old shrines and Priest Rods lose their god.\
\
For a God Soul, the final blow must be a Saronite Sword strike by a player carrying an empty glass bottle. Other finishing attacks still remove the god but yield no soul.\
\
See [God Soul harvesting](entry://anima:codex/infusion/tools).

The avatar vanishes if the activating player dies, logs out or changes dimension. Beyond 64 blocks from the hammer, return within ten seconds; beyond 96, it ends immediately. Peaceful also ends it. The god survives.\
\
Breaking the hammer after descent does not stop combat. Reuse a surviving hammer with fresh offerings.
